text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh! Outta the way! Move!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun comes running straight
at me, but I somehow
manage to safely
stop her.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Sorry about that. And thanks for catching me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
I guess this isn't the first time this
has happened.

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You get back here right this instant,
Mayano! For the last time, I'm
telling you
to turn in your homework today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoops. Now isn't the time to talk!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I gotta scramble outta here!
Catch you later!

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she can be such a handful! She's too
quick for her own good. I'm
sorry, but
could you give her a talking-to as well?

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
She needs to submit her homework, unless
she wants detention eating
into her
training time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly search for my troublemaking
trainee, only to find her
hiding under my
desk in the trainers' office.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh—oh wait, it's just you. I don't mind
being found by you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Where'd my teacher go? She isn't here, right? Phew... I thought I was done for!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's no fair! She gives me extra homework
just 'cause I fall asleep
during class!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I only slept while we were reviewing
yesterday's stuff! Besides, I can
just figure
it all out if I read the textbook!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She also tells me to "show my work" or
whatever on our tests, but who
cares as
long as the answer's right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Why does she keep picking on me?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I totally forgot about that!
Detention makes me lose out on
training!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Urk. I didn't care much about training
before, but now... Argh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Why does this have to happen after I decide to start training with you?! All I wanted was to become a twinkly grown-up...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... But I don't wanna do
homework... Blegh...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Something new?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's different... I think... Okay, maybe
not, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A new discovery, huh? Hrm...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All I can think of is how boring it'd be!
But
like...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you're saying that it'd help,
I guess it
wouldn't hurt to try...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But! If I do this, I'm going to need
something in return. Like another
date! ♪
And it has to be something grown-ups do!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Got it?! You got it, right?! Yaaay! Where
should we go this time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun hums happily to herself
as she finishes her
homework.
